claims.claim: Q2 2026 showed robust global tower leasing and record CoreSite leasing, indicating simultaneous wireless and data-center demand exposure.

risks.risk: Tower organic growth remains exposed to carrier churn and interest-rate-sensitive REIT financing.

unknowns.unknown: Durability of record CoreSite leasing beyond the reported quarter remains unproven.

claims.claim: Q2 revenue rose 4.7%, property revenue 6.3%, adjusted EBITDA 3.2%, AFFO 3.8%, and operating cash flow 16% year over year; management raised full-year outlook for a second time.

risks.risk: Reported net-income growth is heavily distorted by foreign-currency comparison effects; AFFO growth is the cleaner execution signal.

unknowns.unknown: Forward leasing conversion and financing-cost trajectory require subsequent-quarter validation.
